        fundperf - categoryperf AS outperformance
    FROM annual_returns 
    WHERE portfolioref = 'AADR' 
      AND fundperf IS NOT NULL 
      AND categoryperf IS NOT NULL
),
aadr_trend AS (
    SELECT 
        calendaryear,
        outperformance,
        LAG(outperformance) OVER (ORDER BY calendaryear) AS prior_year_outperformance,
        outperformance - LAG(outperformance) OVER (ORDER BY calendaryear) AS yoy_change
    FROM aadr_outperformance
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN yoy_change > 0 THEN 1 END) AS improving_years,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN yoy_change < 0 THEN 1 END) AS worsening_years
FROM aadr_trend;
